title: Valid Sudoku Configuration - Solution
intuition: Determine if a 9 x 9 Sudoku board is valid. Only the filled cells need to be validated according to the Sudoku rules.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
time_complexity: O(1) because size of board is fixed
common_mistakes: Track rows, columns, and 3x3 subboxes seen values using sets.
